outcome: Complete Phase 4 Host Projections as one coordinated product outcome: define the immutable host-projection receipt contract first, then implement one safe three-host projection engine so Codex, Copilot, and Claude consume the same frozen bundled-v2 identity through fixed copy or reference modes with atomic projection, complete read-only conformance, idempotence, and no network or mutable rediscovery.

shared_proof.asserted_behavior: The registered receipt contract and the three-host engine jointly prove one frozen official identity, fixed Codex copy and Copilot and Claude reference modes, atomic and idempotent projection, complete read-only conformance, fail-closed negative states, and no network, substitution, mutable rediscovery, or Full-to-Lite fallback.

success_criteria: The host-projection receipt schema is registered and available before the engine emits or validates a receipt.
Codex, Copilot, and Claude conformance results agree on the exact official, project-pack, and run-resolution identity.
Codex copy mode validates a closed destination inventory and Copilot and Claude reference modes validate bounded managed instruction blocks and immutable receipts.
Read-only status detects every missing, additional, altered, symlinked, non-regular, unsafe, stale, incompatible, legacy, and conflicting state without mutation.
Identical retries are idempotent and no host downloads, substitutes, rediscovers mutable selector state, or silently changes Full mode.
Phase 5 distribution, public Start and MCP qualification, packaging matrix, and release documentation remain outside this approval.
